verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud, so spot or interruptible capacity is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents spot, preemptible, or interruptible instances, or any preemption semantics. The 'Save up to 70% on compute costs' claim is a general comparison with major public clouds, not a discounted interruptible tier, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can rent spot or interruptible GPU capacity at a deep discount with clearly documented preemption semantics
